aoj-baidu-1.webp.zh: 航站楼内的迎宾装置：木质字母拼出的「Welcome to AOMORI」旁立着两只木芥子人偶。
aoj-baidu-1.webp.en: Inside the terminal: 'Welcome to AOMORI' spelled in wooden letters beside two traditional kokeshi dolls.

aoj-baidu-2.webp.zh: 行李提取大厅：环形传送带绕着木饰面圆柱，墙上是青森四季主题的灯箱画。
aoj-baidu-2.webp.en: The baggage hall — carousels winding around timber-clad columns beneath backlit panels of Aomori's seasons.

aoj-baidu-3.webp.zh: 候机区的「AOMORI AIRPORT FOREST DINING」餐饮区：暖色木质柜台与绿意玻璃墙，右侧是餐座。
aoj-baidu-3.webp.en: The 'AOMORI AIRPORT FOREST DINING' food court — a warm timber counter against a leafy glass wall, tables to the right.
